attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 16 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **Three head names, three folders**, and this is the only one of the three that becomes a folder: Isaacius and Simeon are both upgrades of folders the corpus already keeps on this same menologion day from the Romanian side, `isaac-the-persian-of-metsovo` and `simeon-martyr-16-may`. **Nothing in the corpus reads like this name at all** — the name sweep for the line returned no `!!` row that touches it — so there is no identity question to leave open. **The display name carries no epithet** because the page gives him none: no see, no city, no country of his own beyond the Persian king before whom the three were brought, and no rank but Άγιος and the fire. **No `dates` object**: the page gives two reigns spanning more than a century and no year. **No hymn.**
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
